articles.title: Alchemy's AI-driven identity and payment service gains access to Visa network
articles.snippet: The AgentCard integration with Visa Intelligent Commerce allows AI agents built on models from any provider, including OpenAI or Anthropic, to effect commercial transactions.

articles.title: GPT-5.6 Rumors Heat Up as Users Swear ChatGPT Suddenly Got Smarter
articles.snippet: Many AI users are convinced that OpenAI is quietly running GPT-5.6 inside ChatGPT. OpenAI isn't confirming anything.

articles.title: Amazon Won't Release Sam Altman Film 'Artificial' Following $50 Billion OpenAI Investment
articles.snippet: Amazon is pulling out of "Artificial," a film about Sam Altman's brief ouster from OpenAI, not long after investing $50 billion in the firm.
